name: superwork
description: Continuous design, planning, TDD, debugging, and verification workflows for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Structured development workflows that continue by default.
interface.longDescription: Route repository work through design, planning, TDD, debugging, and fresh verification, stopping early only when the user explicitly asks.
defaultPrompt: Start a repository task with the appropriate Superwork workflow.
